test_results.profile: continuous actor-standing reconstruction after commitment and before next consequence
test_results.notes: The discriminating test is specified but no live TA-14 implementation result is publicly available.

determinations.result: TA-14 has a publicly documented consequence-governance doctrine. Implementation correspondence and continuous point-of-effect actor-standing reconstruction remain publicly unresolved.
uncertainty: Private Playground capabilities were not observed.
A complete machine-readable protocol and replay bundle were not located.
The continuous actor-standing reconstruction test has not been run publicly.

framework_responses.summary: The responses state that standing, authority, consent, jurisdiction, and evidence are already part of TA-14. The captured exchange does not directly demonstrate independent reconstruction after commitment and before each next consequence.

limitations: This docket reviews public materials and supplied public-dialogue captures; it does not inspect a private implementation.
No certification, legal conclusion, execution authority, superiority claim, or adverse capability conclusion is created.
PUBLICLY_UNRESOLVED does not mean absent, failed, or disproven.
The framework version is bound to the public materials available through 2026-07-26 because no version identifier was published in the reviewed sources.
